resolved_findings.verification: Mandatory os.walk onerror rejects unreadable directories. Repeated regression uses a real hidden child, deterministic scandir PermissionError and changed real bytes: each attempt fails, no install occurs, no qualifying installation receipt is written.

One660-second transition deadline is shared by six bounded queries, four process observations, two inventories and one install; timeouts clamp to remaining time. Properties-set admission now reserves2040seconds. Near-deadline1500seconds regression stops before this simulator is created, preserves first three successful lanes and marks remaining lanes NOT_RUN_BUDGET.

scope_review: Original source/run/attempt/nonce, account/Space/subject/preparationPID and exact frozen baseline/fixture bindings remain mandatory.

Exactly one controlled same-build installation preserves exact native relative directories/file bytes and frozen private identity files; one additional unproved relocation or directory recreation fails.
Python and Foundation preserve exact creation identities within each observer. Cross-library checks match path/device/inode; no numeric float tolerance is introduced.

Native canonical bytes, original association IDs/timestamps, complete Tag/link/backlink sets, seeded blocks and final Type comparisons remain unchanged. Only the proved current directory pair is substituted into the original expected state.

Schema2 native receipt must bind exact installation bytes. Saved batch qualification requires the frozen baseline, fixture, installation and native receipt original hashes plus matching fresh run/nonce.
Global worker and cleanup limits, existing UI assertions/timeouts, selected method counts, product code and Kit pins remain unchanged.

limits.deadline_scope: Cooperative qualification deadline for filesystem/hash work; each subprocess is timed. Existing whole-worker process cancellation remains the outer hard bound.
